# Gramlot examples 0.3.6 — Load teaching content when visible

- Start an example after its own Source arrives, without waiting for code or the Explanation body. Panes and iframes are still created only on first selection.
- Load Code and Explanation through the existing Source method only when their panels are visible, including drawer and mobile presentation. Retain loaded content and deduplicate pending requests.
- Keep the code pane stable during content replacement so tab switching preserves the same iframe and entered Data. Secondary request failures can be retried without discarding the running example.
- Apply the same behavior to Python, JavaScript and the serverless export; no core or adapter contract changes.

Verified with 112 JavaScript and 19 Python tests and Chromium/WebKit checks for desktop/mobile visibility, retained Data and the file-based export.
